body:
New internal/emitter/pattern.go: patternToPCRE lowers a parsed Pattern AST (§19-29) into the exact PCRE syntax text format PARENA's own real regex/pcre.prn (compile/is-match) consumes. Verified against the literal PCRE text every one of the doc's own §20-29 worked examples shows, plus a real correctness case the doc doesn't cover (literal text containing PCRE metacharacters comes out escaped). One real, honest, named gap: ESCAPE GROUP has no unambiguous ( vs ) mapping, reported as an error rather than guessed. Real, explicitly-named next step: wiring this text into an actual regex/pcre/compile+is-match .prn call needs a caller-supplied Arena, which breaks LO's existing zero-arg 'name it main' verification trick -- confirmed against PARENA/tests/test_base4_pattern.c that PARENA's own Arena-taking self-test convention always threads the Arena in externally. LO also still has no String-typed value for MATCH's subject. 24 new emitter tests (string-output only, no compile/run yet). 65 tests total, GOWORK=off go build/vet/test ./... clean. commit 5969325.

⚓ ☃
title: Pattern-to-PCRE-text lowering in the emitter
